name: ROH-AP002
summary: ROH-AP002 is OYMotion's hybrid tactile and force-controlled dexterous hand for robotic manipulation and contact-data collection. The manufacturer describes normal and tangential force measurement on the fingers, supplemented by a palm pressure array, to provide feedback for compliant grasping. The detailed page lists a 626 ±5 g mass including the wrist, 24 V supply and UART, RS485 and CAN interfaces. ROS/ROS2 integration is supported. Its large lifting and single-finger load figures are structural or specified-posture ratings, and should not be interpreted as active fingertip force.

description.zh: 五指机器人灵巧手，具有6个主动自由度、11个运动关节，结合一维与三维力感知，实现闭环操作。

sources.title: oy-ROH-AP002
sources.quote: ROH-AP002 dexterous hand features 11 movable joints, with 6 built-in motor drivers and motor control circuits, providing 6 active degrees of freedom. Equipped with a built-in PID motor control algorithm, it can simulate various human hand grasping operations. Each finger is fitted with a force sensor, enabling real-time monitoring and control of gripping force. Typical applications include robotic end-effectors, educational and research equipment, and bionic prosthetics, etc. ROH-AP002 dexterous hand with UART, RS485 or CAN physical interface, support SerialCtrl dedicated serial protocol, ModBus-RTU protocol and CAN protocol, can provide ROS / ROS2 platforms for secondary development with SDK.
